status: RESEARCH HYPOTHESES - not approved, not validated, no orders

hypotheses.A_rejection: Price trades beyond the prior completed profile's VAH (VAL), a completed candle closes back inside the value area; reversal toward POC or the opposite boundary has positive expectancy after costs.
hypotheses.B_breakout_retest: A completed candle closes beyond VAH (VAL), price retests the broken boundary and the next completed candle still closes outside; continuation has positive expectancy after costs.

btc_dev.role: development (chronological walk-forward); period previously examined by other BTC strategies, never by Volume Profile

xau_dev.role: development (chronological walk-forward); 2019-2020 prices were examined by the rejected scalping test (PR #19), never by Volume Profile

xau_val.role: chronological validation of frozen dev selections (single run); prices previously examined by other XAU strategies, never by Volume Profile - NOT unseen data

btc_final.role: genuinely unexamined BTC/USDT history (2017-08 .. 2018-12, never used in this project); frozen parameters pre-registered before download

benchmarks: 20 matched random-entry seeds (same signal frame, count, side share, stop distance in ATR, reward-to-risk distribution)
time-at-price (TPO) profile levels with identical rules (no volume information)
prior-period high/low range levels with identical rules (no profile)

btcusdt.base: 0.10% taker fee per side, spread 0.01, slippage 2 USDT

xauusd.base: commission 0, slippage 0.10, dataset historical spread p50 by New York hour

multiple_testing: walk-forward selection inside training windows only; deflated Sharpe ratio (Bailey & Lopez de Prado) of the best full-grid configuration against all 96 trials per market; every grid result reported

dev_candidate: walk-forward OOS mean R > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
OOS net return > 0 under the market's stress costs
OOS mean R beats >= 18 of 20 matched random seeds
>= 60% of OOS windows with positive net return
deflated Sharpe ratio of the variant's best full-grid configuration >= 0.95
decision_rules.volume_adds_information: volume-level OOS mean R minus TPO-level and minus range-level OOS mean R both with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
decision_rules.xau_validation: frozen most-selected parameters: mean R > 0 with CI lower bound > 0 and net > 0 under stress costs
decision_rules.shadow_test: only a variant passing every applicable rule may be proposed for a separately pre-registered prospective shadow test
